news.title:
Jash Engineering Ltd held its Q4 2026 earnings call on May 27, 2026.
The call covered financial highlights, growth plans, and forward-looking statements.

Jash Engineering's Q4 FY26 net profit rose 56.9% YoY to Rs 56.69 crore.
FY26 net profit fell 13.1% to Rs 76.18 crore; sales remained flat at Rs 736.19 crore.
JASH: Dividend Track Record And Maintained Fair Value Will Support Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have maintained the fair value estimate for Jash Engineering at ₹600, while making modest adjustments to assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E to reflect an updated view of the company’s risk profile and earnings potential. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for May 26, 2026 to consider and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, to recommend a final dividend for FY 2025-26, to appoint M/s.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹12.01 (down from ₹14.03 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹7.57b (up 2.9% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹761.8m (down 13% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 10% (down from 12% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 4.6%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 5.0%. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 10% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 26% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Jash Engineering Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the year ended 31 March 2026
news.body: Jash Engineering Limited at its Board of Directors Meeting held on May 26, 2026, recommended a final Dividend of INR 1.00 per fully paid-up equity share of INR 2 each for the year ended 31 March 2026, subject To Approve the shareholders of the Company at the ensuing Annual General Meeting of the Company.

news.title: JASH: Interim Dividend And Stable Assumptions Will Support Future Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have kept the fair value estimate for Jash Engineering steady at ₹600, with a slightly higher discount rate and P/E assumption used to support this unchanged price target. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for May 26, 2026 to review and approve the audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, along with the auditor's report, and to consider a final dividend for FY 2025-26, if any (company filing).

news.title: JASH: Interim Dividend Decision Will Support Earnings Outlook And Positive Re Rating
news.body: Analysts have kept the Jash Engineering price target steady at ₹600. They cite largely unchanged assumptions on revenue growth, profit margins and forward P/E, with a slightly higher discount rate now factored into their models.

news.title: Upcoming dividend of ₹0.60 per share
news.body: Eligible shareholders must have bought the stock before 10 April 2026. Payment date: 29 May 2026. Payout ratio is a comfortable 14% and this is well supported by cash flows. Trailing yield: 0.7%. Lower than top quartile of Indian dividend payers (1.7%). Lower than average of industry peers (1.1%).

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 33%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹8.31b to ₹7.72b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹16.90 per share to ₹11.40 per share. Net income forecast to grow 92% next year vs 29% growth forecast for Machinery industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹663 to ₹600. Share price was steady at ₹400 over the past week.

news.title: JASH: Upcoming Board Meeting Will Clarify Earnings Outlook And Support Bullish View
news.body: The analyst price target for Jash Engineering has been revised from ₹685 to ₹600. Analysts cited updates to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions as the key drivers behind the change.

news.title: Price target decreased by 12% to ₹600
news.body: Down from ₹685, the current price target is provided by 1 analyst. New target price is 47% above last closing price of ₹409. Stock is down 19% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹11.40 for next year compared to ₹14.03 last year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.38 (vs ₹5.54 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.38 (down from ₹5.54 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.65b (down 8.9% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹134.1m (down 62% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.1% (down from 19% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was primarily driven by lower revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 20% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 15% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 31% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Now 22% undervalued after recent price drop
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 16% to ₹387. The fair value is estimated to be ₹495, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 26% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 24%. Revenue is forecast to grow by 18% in a year. Earnings are forecast to grow by 58% in the next year.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹409, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 21x. Average forward P/E is 30x in the Machinery industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 136% over the past three years.
